claims.text: Oral terbinafine: most nail and scalp infections, resistant skin infections, or pts unwilling or unable to keep up prolonged topical tx; dose and duration vary by site.
claims.quote: Oral antifungals (eg, terbinafine, itraconazole) are used for most nail and scalp infections, resistant skin infections, and patients unwilling or unable to adhere to prolonged topical regimens; doses and duration differ by site of infection.
claims.locator: Treatment of Dermatophytoses › Topical or oral antifungals

claims.text: Oral terbinafine > 4 wk: baseline and periodic liver tests (significant hepatic abnormalities are rare).
claims.quote: For the oral antifungal agents terbinafine and itraconazole, baseline and periodic liver testing is generally advised if treatment extends beyond 4 weeks, as clinically significant hepatic abnormalities are rare but can occur (1).
claims.locator: Treatment of Dermatophytoses › Topical or oral antifungals
